plan.selection: Fixed clone IDs inherited from frozen main plan; ROI1 center as reference and ROI4 southwest chosen from the previously reported ~10-minute limiting margin. Outcome-informed point selection is explicit and not independent confirmation. No clone outcomes read before this plan.

semantics.section: Section 3 and Figure 11: observation-filtered minus simulated terrain gives Z error, added to original LDEM to construct a clone. Downloaded official filenames end in _err.tif; near-zero values and GeoTIFF metadata are also checked.
semantics.units: Z metres; planar XY metres; 5 m raster spacing
semantics.referenceFrame: MOON_ME DE421, south polar stereographic; radius 1737400 m
semantics.missingData: Any missing or nonfinite clone field inside nominal valid local terrain makes that clone unknown, never zero. A failed source or point query retains both planned point records as unknown where applicable.
semantics.sign: Add signed official Z error to the original surface; positive raises surface height. Observer and all local horizon samples use that same realization.
semantics.spatialCorrelation: Use complete official raster without reshuffling, independent pixel noise or RMS-to-angle conversion. Preserve joint local ground/occluder field.
semantics.observer: Each clone observer elevation = bilinear original surface + bilinear same error field, then +2 m. Exact changed elevation sent to Horizons for separate 5-minute Sun/Earth predictions.
semantics.regionalBoundary: Only Site01 local errors represented. Outside local tile use fixed regional DEM; no regional covariance is available. Product seam and far-field errors remain unknown.

limits: 5 of 100 official realizations, selected by fixed ID: no probabilities, quantiles or confidence coverage.
2 of 18 prior audited locations only: no claim about nine-point whole-footprint worst case.
Same source model and own runner; not independent external validation.
0.5 degree azimuth, refined radial sampling; finite ray/DEM and 5-minute cadence limitations remain.

interpretation.scopeChange: No point, clone ID, threshold or interval changes. Correct official file representation and compare numeric CRS parameters rather than display names before any clone horizon or altered-observer query.

officialEvidence.location: Site01 Clones links to the exact files used
officialEvidence.meaning: Files are presented as LDEM clones, not a separate generic noise raster.

officialEvidence.quote: Clones/ : Directory containing 100 clones of LDEM

officialEvidence.meaning: A clone is the original LDEM plus its spatially structured signed error; the error map and clone surface are distinct.

interpretation.observedSupportingCheck: GeoTIFF Z ranges match original surface; clone-minus-base spans about -5 to +6 metres and RMS about 0.44m. This is corroboration, not sole semantic evidence. File suffix _err.tif does not mean the stored numbers are errors.
interpretation.representation: absolute clone surface height in metres, used directly; signed diagnostic error = clone surface minus nominal surface
interpretation.operation: Local occluder heights and observer ground sampled from the SAME full clone. Keep 2m equipment above that ground; request exact changed observer-height ephemerides. Do not add clone heights to base.
interpretation.crs: Equivalent numeric south-polar stereographic parameters/R=1737400m/units metre and exact 5m transform/dimensions required. WKT labels unnamed vs unknown differ but not projection. MOON_ME DE421 per official product metadata.
interpretation.missingData: Nonfinite or nodata anywhere nominal local surface is valid rejects that clone; missing query/source records remain unknown, never zero.
interpretation.farField: Outside local tile: unchanged regional80m DEM. Regional uncertainties and tile seam effects remain unverified.
interpretation.noProbability: Five fixed official clone IDs at two selected points; no frequency-to-probability or nine-point/full-horizon certification.
